notes.text: Full different-reader audit of scan025 only. Original once and both native halves once; all nine existing reader-C locus crops reused once each. One crop was created for the genuinely new lower-functor source-graph locus, which had no existing crop. Neither cancellation was recropped.

The sole proposed transcription change is graphical: the second functor’s Lambda-shaped source has an additional cap and inner descending stroke. TikZ preserves them without naming an underlying T, pi or other letter and without adding a deletion state. The first functor source remains the ordinary Lambda.

The single deleted illegible-word placeholder before suppose satisfies the convention: it covers physically unreadable prose-word material, not a mathematical symbol. The baseline residues and final loop/upright are separate from the preceding line’s large foncteur descender. No guessed word is supplied.

All three original MARKS decisions are retained: M0706 ce, M0707 remontée, and M0708 positional treatment of the lower doubtful t-like sign. The unusual ce condition, internal index separator uncertainty, extra closing family parenthesis and four final continuation marks remain literal.

Inserted On is visibly above the canceled D-word but has no independent attachment caret or guide. The marginal note has no separate connecting guide beyond the main condition’s brace. No guide is invented from word descenders or retraced glyph strokes.

The source’s mathematical claims were read as background in this audit. No new proof was performed. The accepted first-pass report contains a separately attributed main-reader targeted proof check; that pre-existing entry and the accepted report were not altered.
The final comment reads élucidant and ends at de. Pencil pagination 24 remains assigned to an unidentified hand. H’s editorial description of the margin is not source text.
